observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same setup: a Nikon DSLR camera body with a lens mounted on top, placed on a Nikon D3200 18-55 VR II Kit box.
The camera body is black with 'Nikon' and 'D3200' clearly visible on the top right.
The lens is labeled 'Nikon AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR II'.
The box also shows 'D3200 18-55 VR II Kit' with the same lens and camera model.
The background includes a window with reflections of a store or studio setup, including a 'LED L60' sign.
The watermark 'PHOTOPLUG INTEGRATED' is visible on both photos.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.
The lens is labeled 'f/3.5-5.6G VR II', which implies a range of ISO settings, but the exact ISO range is not visible on the lens or camera. The claim is not directly verifiable from the photos.
This is a software feature of the camera model, not visible in the photos. Cannot be confirmed remotely.
The seller's text claims '3.0"', but no photo shows this clearly enough to read.
